title: Nice bamboo tub caddy
text: Nice bamboo tub caddy. This caddy is very nice.  I love that it's made of bamboo and not plastic.  It has a place for a wine glass and a book holder, plus room for soap or whatever else you need.  The metal sides expand to fit the tub.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Standard Bamboo Bathtub Caddy Tray
features: Bamboo caddy sits over edges of your bathtub
Polished chrome side attachments expand to fit most standard tubs
Place products and accessories on its surface for easy access while bathing
Recessed wine glass holder and extra storage hooks
Made of real bamboo with a beautiful, natural finish
